subject: Private CP access mapping & edge-proxy trust anchors — onboarding questions
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@helmtech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@helmtech.com
Date: Fri, 02 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: Private CP access mapping & edge-proxy trust anchors

Hi Logan / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. We're starting the internal kickoff for our Private Control Plane deployment and have a few follow-ups so we can complete our risk assessment and procurement packet. Specific asks: 

- Can you share a clear mapping of SAML attributes -> Redwood roles (we'll use this in our SSO checklist)?
- How does SCIM group provisioning map to role grants (one-to-many vs one-to-one)?
- For the edge-proxy that sits in our VPC, we need the trust anchor/cert chain expectations (PEM format) and whether the proxy will call the control plane over mTLS or regular TLS with client cert validation.
- Any required firewall egress rules from our private subnets to Redwood control plane endpoints?

We're aiming to have procurement and security sign-off by 3/16; if you can get the mapping and cert stub this week that would be ideal.

Attached: our vendor-questionnaire (not included here).

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Head of Cloud Security, HelmTech

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@helmtech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Private CP access mapping & edge-proxy trust anchors

Sarah —

Thanks, and great list. I've attached a first-pass access-mapping spreadsheet (access-mapping-draft.xlsx) and a PEM stub for the edge-proxy trust anchor (edge-proxy-trust-anchor.pem). High-level answers below; detailed notes are in the spreadsheet.

Summary:
- SAML -> Redwood role mapping: We recommend mapping SAML group claims to Redwood role names (group-to-role). Avoid mapping individual users directly. Use SAML attribute name "groups" (or "memberOf") and our role namespace prefix "rw_". Example: HelmTech "rw-admins" -> Redwood "OrgAdmin". 
- SCIM: Provision groups as SCIM groups (members list) and sync group displayName -> Redwood role. We support incremental updates and full replace. Groups are one-to-one to Redwood roles; users can be in multiple groups.
- Edge-proxy: We accept TLS (server cert validation) from our control plane; for extra assurance we support mutual TLS from edge-proxy to control plane. If you run the proxy in your VPC and cannot do mTLS, ensure strict cert validation and pinned trust anchor (we can provide the PEM to pin).
- Network: Egress to control-plane endpoints (control.redwood.example:443, auth.redwood.example:443) + outbound NTP. IP ranges are listed in the sheet.

Next steps:
- Dev will follow up with the specific IAM role ARNs and ephemeral cert flow.
- If you need RBAC exceptions/canary plan, we can produce a short rollout playbook — propose a 3-week phased canary.

Attached: access-mapping-draft.xlsx, edge-proxy-trust-anchor.pem

Best,
Logan Wright
Manager, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@helmtech.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Mar 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Private CP access mapping & edge-proxy trust anchors

Sarah — quick technical details to add to Logan's summary: 

- Role assumption/authorization: For Private CP we mint short-lived session tokens tied to a Redwood service account. Workflow options:
  * SCIM provisioned groups -> map to Redwood role -> role binding issues scoped to organization/project; users assume role via SAML assertion;
  * For programmatic workloads inside your VPC, we support issuing OIDC tokens via a short-lived certificate exchange (SPIFFE-like) or role-ARN-based STS token.

- Ephemeral certs: Edge-proxy can request client certs from our CA for mTLS; TTLs default to 1h. We rotate intermediate certs monthly. We'll include the CSR/CSR-approval flow in the playbook.

- SCIM field mapping (from spreadsheet):
  * scim.groups.displayName -> redwood.role.name
  * scim.groups.members -> redwood.role.members (member emails)
  * scim.users.externalId -> redwood.user.external_id (recommended to keep immutable)

- Audit logs: All SAML assertions and role assignments are logged with request IDs and stored in the Private CP audit bucket for 90 days by default (configurable).

I'll attach a short sample policy snippet here for your ops team (embedded below).

----- SAMPLE POLICY SNIPPET -----
resource "redwood_role_binding" "helmtech_admins" {
  role = "OrgAdmin"
  group = "rw-helmtech-admins"
  enforcement = "canary:3/1000"  # apply canary 0.3% for first 24h
}
----- END SNIPPET -----

If HelmTech prefers one-to-many group mapping (one SCIM group -> multiple Redwood roles), we can support it but it requires an explicit role mapping table in the control plane. It's simpler and safer to keep group -> role one-to-one.

- Firewall: minimal egress (443 to control plane, 9000/metrics optional), and a port for our certificate validation callback (we can NAT it out if necessary).

Happy to jump on a short call to walk through the sheet.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@helmtech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@helmtech.com
Date: Wed, 07 Mar 2028 10:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Private CP access mapping & edge-proxy trust anchors

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifying concerns from our InfoSec reviewer: 

- Can you confirm retention and export controls for SAML assertion logs? We need to demonstrate how to pull a user's historical assertions for audits (sorted by timestamp and request-id).
- For mTLS: If we request client certs, will Redwood rotate the CA without breaking existing pinned proxies? How will we coordinate CA rollover?
- SCIM rate limits: our directory sync will push 10k users and 150 groups initially; what's the expected throttling behavior and backoff guidance?

Also — procurement asks: do you have a sample MOU for network isolation and key handling for Private CP? We need it for internal sign-off.

If you can provide the audit sample and a short CA rollover procedure, we should be able to close security sign-off next week.

Thanks,
Sarah

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@helmtech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Mar 2028 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Private CP access mapping & edge-proxy trust anchors

Sarah —

Short answers and an action plan attached (privcp-canary-playbook.md).

- Audit export: you can query the audit store via our control-plane API (audit.redwood.example/v1/queries) using user_email or request_id; exports are CSV/JSON and we provide a signed download link. Retention is configurable per org; default 90d. We'll include a sample query and the resulting CSV in the folder.
- CA rollover: we support cross-signed intermediates. Recommended approach: Redwood publishes the new intermediate, you add the new intermediate to your pin list; we switch server certs on T0+48h and revoke old intermediate at T0+14d. We'll provide a timeline template and notify via our Ops channel.
- SCIM limits: initial bulk import should use our bulk SCIM endpoint (batch size 5000 users / 250 groups per request). For incremental syncs, target 2k reqs/minute with exponential backoff; default 429 windows return Retry-After. We'll include a recommended backoff algorithm in the playbook.

Playbook highlights:
- Week 0: test tenant provisioning + sample SCIM sync (staging).
- Week 1: canary policy: 0.5% of OrgAdmins mapped, monitor auth failures and audit spikes.
- Week 2: 10% rollout, expand to programmatic cert issuance.
- Week 3: full cutover and post-cutover 72h monitoring.

I'll push the playbook and the sample MOU draft to the Drive link and open a DocuSign envelope for the MOU if you want to accelerate procurement.

If HelmTech wants, we can do a short 30-min runbook review with your security ops on Monday.

Next steps:
- I will upload: privcp-canary-playbook.md, sample_audit_query.json, mou-draft.pdf to the Drive folder (link below).
- Laura will own the DocuSign MOU follow-through.
